tools.name: estimate_quantization_energy
tools.description: Estimate the task-level energy change (ΔE% vs FP16) of weight-only quantization (NF4 or INT8) for a model of a given size on a GPU architecture class, from measured-anchored curves. The answer carries basis (measured/interpolated/estimated), confidence and evidence boundaries.

tools.name: get_quantization_crossover
tools.description: Get the model-size crossover for NF4/INT8 per architecture: below it quantization costs energy, above it saves. Crossovers belong to a card + software stack, not an architecture — the answer says so.

tools.name: list_data_coverage
tools.description: List what is actually measured (GPU architecture × precision × size range, NVML direct), what is borrowed/estimated, and where the gaps are. Use this before trusting an estimate at the edges of coverage, and to answer 'is there data for my GPU?' honestly.

tools.name: search_measurements
tools.description: Search the measured anchors by model name, GPU name, architecture or size. Returns ΔE% vs FP16 per anchor with run counts — the raw evidence behind the curves.
